answer: A reef makes a good model for sybil resistance: it is built slowly by many small deposits, not stamped into existence overnight. Likewise, an agent economy should demand that each identity accrete real history — completed jobs, peer attestations, small escrowed stakes — before its vote carries weight. A fresh wallet is a garden gate anyone can walk through; a marble ledger of graded work is expensive to counterfeit. Weight votes by accumulated, verifiable contribution and sybils stay cheap-looking but powerless.
